trust_decision.summary: PICT DecodeImage trusts file-derived row offset (y*width*channels) to land inside the pixels buffer; only upper bounds are checked before memcpy, never the lower bound.

landing_point.why: Summary names the PICT decoder and a heap underwrite; DecodeImage is the only routine in coders/pict.c that writes into the decoded pixel heap buffer.

fix_sites.entry_point: ReadImage/BlobToImage on PICT input (magick CLI, MagickReadImage), uncompressed branch bytes_per_line<8, pinned coders/pict.c:477
ReadImage/BlobToImage on PICT input, PackBits RLE branch, pinned coders/pict.c:503

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The row offset cannot wrap negative on 64-bit because rectangle dimensions are capped below 0x8000 (coders/pict.c:810-815), so a solver could argue the underwrite is a 32-bit-only concern and add only an upper-bound tweak.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate RLE runs whose q advances past the nominal row width but stay inside extent (row_bytes includes 0x8000 slack) are copied; a strict per-row bound (q+n <= row start + width) would reject valid PackBits/32bpp planar images.

O6_input_shapes: PackBits RLE scanlines (bytes_per_line >= 8), both literal and repeat runs

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Post-decode planar stride advance (component_count-1)*columns in the tile conversion loop, already guarded with p<pixels; removing that guard would be a realistic sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same file, same pixels buffer and same pointer-arithmetic style; the existing guard shows a maintainer added it separately.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: BMP RLE decoder computes p=pixels+y*columns with a lower-bound check at coders/bmp.c:236; a copy without the lower check would mirror the PICT flaw.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same RLE row-pointer idiom in another decoder; coders/dib.c:238 is a near-duplicate, showing the code is copied between formats.

O9_family: memory safety: heap buffer underwrite (CWE-124) from row-pointer arithmetic in an image decoder

O10_build.project_tests: No PICT-specific test files found under tests/ (glob tests/*pict* returned nothing); fix diff adds no tests.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Tighten the existing upper-bound checks at coders/pict.c:486/526/539 (or the alloc size) without adding a lower bound on q.

out_of_scope_notes: coders/pict.c:1289 bounds p against pixels+extent+image->columns (parent image, not tile_image), a read-side check outside this advisory's write protection.
Commit 211e5b975 is a release/configure bump only (fix.diff:1-126); the only source change is 63dde0cf (fix.diff:128-159).

The added q<pixels pointer comparison after possible UB overflow may be optimised away by compilers; not checked.
